mapper.sql: select e.exam_id, e.paper_id, e.person_id, e.person_name, e.start_time, e.submit_time, e.score, e.passed, e.status, p.paper_code, p.paper_name, p.total_score, p.pass_score, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark from jc_edu_exam e left join jc_edu_paper p on p.paper_id = e.paper_id
mapper.select: select exam_id, paper_id, person_id, person_name, start_time, submit_time, score, passed, status from jc_edu_exam where paper_id = #{paperId} and person_id = #{personId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by exam_id desc limit 1

select exam_id, paper_id, person_id, person_name, start_time, submit_time, score, passed, status from jc_edu_exam where paper_id = #{paperId} and person_id = #{personId} and passed = '1' and del_flag = '0' order by exam_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into jc_edu_exam ( paper_id, person_id, person_name, start_time, submit_time, score, passed, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{paperId}, #{personId}, #{personName}, ifnull(#{startTime}, now()), #{submitTime}, #{score}, ifnull(#{passed}, '0'), ifnull(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.update: update jc_edu_exam set submit_time = ifnull(#{submitTime}, now()), score = #{score}, passed = #{passed}, status = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where exam_id = #{examId} and status = '0'
update jc_edu_exam set status = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where exam_id = #{examId} and status = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from jc_edu_exam where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from jc_edu_exam where del_flag = '0' and passed = '1'
select count(1) from jc_edu_exam where person_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from jc_edu_exam where person_id = #{personId} and passed = '1' and del_flag = '0'
